fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami-area civic and economic conditions, including criticism of a low speed limit on Fifth Street and calls for clearer traffic regulation; arguments for building a practical airport in Biscayne Bay as Miami becomes a hub for air travel; discussion of high seasonal rents and tourist-season pricing; and advocacy for a zoning law to prevent incompatible development. Coverage also includes Coral Gables municipal politics and commission disputes, local entertainment and sports notes (including boxing at the Coral Gables Coliseum), a report on a Florida road-camp killing and trial, and recurring humor and society-style columns, alongside advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach businesses and properties.
